descriptions.notStarted: Sand Bandits, the secret organization that works for the good people in #m260000000#. What can I do to help them? Since #b#p2101012##k of #b#m260010400##k is a member of the Sand Bandits, I should go talk to him.
descriptions.inProgress: #p2101012# told me the time is now to steal a treasure from the queen, and told me to go to the #bpalace#k. Since I can't be detected by the queen, I need to evade the security and the queen, #busing the hidden portals in the castle#k to end up on the queen's treasure chest and steal a #bring#k from there. Wait, why did he want the poisoned needle and the rope? They don't seem to be needed in this.\n\n#i4031578# #t4031578#  #b#c4031578##k/1
descriptions.completed: I gave #p2101012# the ring from the queen's treasure chest. Phew, good thing I did it. Wait... isn't something like this reserved for the experienced members of the team?
